text_block_list.text:
It happened just after finishing a brief 
meeting with Sakura Laurel in the 
Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
A question for you: what does Valentine's 
Day mean to you?
choice_data_list: Valentine's?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes♪ The time is drawing near, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
My mom told me before: "At times like 
this, it's best to check in and make sure 
you're both on the same page."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Mom gave chocolate to Dad a long time 
ago, and apparently, it took him totally 
by surprise."

"Come to think of it, I heard Sakura 
Laurel spent her childhood in France."

"Different hometowns have different 
customs. In that case, Valentine's Day 
might be different too."
choice_data_list: (What Valentine's Day means to me...)

text_block_list.text:
"Besides honmei chocolate, there's another 
tradition that shouldn't be forgotten: 
giri chocolate."

"Even if it carries no romantic meaning, 
it's a great opportunity to express 
gratitude to those who care for you. A 
wonderful chance that comes once a year."
choice_data_list:
I wonder if it's a day for conveying our 
precious feelings.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ooh... I see.

"Right then, I felt like Sakura Laurel and 
I locked eyes with a spark."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Understood. See you tomorrow!

Sakura Laurel walks away with an 
expression that says, "Understood!"

"...Could she be planning to prepare 
obligation chocolate for me?"
choice_data_list: (Maybe I should prepare a return gift.)

text_block_list.text:
"It might just be self-flattery, but being 
thanked by the Umamusume you train is the 
greatest joy a Trainer could ever ask 
for."
choice_data_list:
(...I'd be really happy if that were the 
case.)

text_block_list.text:
With a warm feeling in my chest, I decided 
to buy a single box of chocolates at the 
sweets counter as a small return gift.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wah. Good morning, Trainer! I didn't 
expect to run into you this early.
choice_data_list: (…! A chance already!)

text_block_list.text:
The chocolate I bought the other day is 
hidden in my bag. If she hands me 
something—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Whoops... I'm so sorry! I'm planning to 
study on my own with some friends now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm really looking forward to this 
afternoon! See you then!
choice_data_list: What!? Yeah, see you later...
What!? Yeah, see you later...

text_block_list.text: And even after that...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I had some free time, so I came 
over to chat for a bit! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Once you're done with the workout menu I 
gave you, let's set aside some time for a 
meeting!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm so full...♪
choice_data_list: (We even ate dinner together, but...)

text_block_list.text:
Though there were strangely more chances 
to talk with Sakura Laurel than usual, in 
the end, I never received any courtesy 
chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Well then, all that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...All that's left is to head back, isn't 
it? ........................

"...Maybe because I was so focused on 
giving it in return, the chocolate is 
still sitting in my bag."
choice_data_list: (This is a little embarrassing...)

text_block_list.text:
Instead of taking it home to eat it 
myself, I should give it as a token of 
trust rather than a return gift. Just as I 
was thinking that—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Umm, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Did you forget anything?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Umm, if you need to go grab it, I can wait 
here, though...
choice_data_list: Huh? That's totally fine!

text_block_list.text:
Even if she forgot something, I don't want 
to keep her waiting out in the cold.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Aw, and here I thought you were giving 
it to me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Pardon me! Here, have some 
chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
With all my gratitude to you, Trainer. 
Here you go!
choice_data_list:
...! Actually, I prepared something as 
well—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! You prepared something for me 
too, Trainer?!
choice_data_list:
Yeah! They said it's a return gift for the 
courtesy chocolates!

Yeah! She said it's White Day return for 
the giri choco!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ââ!? O-Obligation, you say...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Geez! It's so mean of you to say that 
right to my face!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I made sure to pour a whuuuule lot of 
gratitude into it, you know?
choice_data_list: ...! S-Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hm. If you reflect on what you did, I 
shall let the matter drop, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...I really did put a whole lot of 
feelings into it, after all."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to tell you how grateful I 
always am.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Even if Trainer did give me something, I 
wanted to share the same feelings, so I 
prepared this."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
My mother did mention that if either 
person is already planning to give 
something, a 'return gift' might not be 
necessary, but...
choice_data_list:
...! Actually, I have something for you in 
return—

...! Actually, I have something for you in 
return too—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Huh...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Then Trainer-san, were you also planning 
to give this to me when you received 
mine...?
choice_data_list:
It's a bit embarrassing, but I actually 
prepared one...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "N-Not at all! I'm so very happy!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...We really are two of a kind, aren't we?
choice_data_list: So you both prepared return gifts, huh.

So you both prepared return gifts, did 
you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...! Hehe, well, that's true too, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Humbled as I am, I truly wanted to receive 
it from you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even knowing I'm just being swayed by 
stereotypes of each country, it's strange 
how...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Said they wanted it from you.

The chocolate I received from Sakura 
Laurel had a truly comforting and gentle 
flavor.
